<!--
  A list or figures beside a picture. Axes: layout (figures: four figures in two columns, proof: three figures
  and a featured review, steps: numbered steps, posts: the latest posts, topics: topic rows with counts,
  contact: contact buttons and support figures), mediaSide, tone. The actions follow every layout but contact.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { MediaExtras, MediaListLabels } from "./media-list.types";
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
import type { Step } from "./steps-list.types";
import type { Post } from "./post-card.types";
import type { Category } from "./category-nav.types";
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
import type { Review } from "./review-list.types";
import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

export type MediaListProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  extras: MediaExtras;
  labels: MediaListLabels;
  actions: LinkActions;
  layout?: "figures" | "proof" | "steps" | "posts" | "topics" | "contact";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.vue";
import MediaContacts from "../components/media-contacts.vue";
import MediaFigures from "../components/media-figures.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import MediaPosts from "../components/media-posts.vue";
import MediaReview from "../components/media-review.vue";
import MediaSteps from "../components/media-steps.vue";
import MediaTopics from "../components/media-topics.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  extras,
  labels,
  actions,
  layout = "figures",
  mediaSide = "end",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<MediaListProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <template v-if="(((layout as string) === 'figures') || ((layout as string) === 'proof'))">
      <MediaFigures
        v-if="((extras.stats?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
        :extras="extras"
        :mode="(((layout as string) === 'proof') ? 'row' : 'grid')"
      />
    </template>
    <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'proof')">
      <MediaReview v-if="((extras.reviews?.length ?? 0) > 0)" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
    </template>
    <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'steps')">
      <MediaSteps v-if="((extras.steps?.length ?? 0) > 0)" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
    </template>
    <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'posts')">
      <MediaPosts v-if="((extras.posts?.length ?? 0) > 0)" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
    </template>
    <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'topics')">
      <MediaTopics v-if="((extras.topics?.length ?? 0) > 0)" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
    </template>
    <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'contact')">
      <MediaContacts v-if="((extras.channels?.length ?? 0) > 0)" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
    </template>
    <ActionGroup v-if="((layout as string) !== 'contact')"
      :primary="actions.cta"
      :primaryHref="actions.href"
      :secondary="((actions.mode === 'two') ? actions.secondary : undefined)"
      :secondaryHref="actions.secondaryHref"
    />
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame
        :alt="title"
        :ratio="((((layout as string) === 'steps') || ((layout as string) === 'topics')) ? '1/1' : '4/3')"
      />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
